patterns.comment: Header keywords. DESIGN_FLOW must precede DESIGN, and BUS_DELIMITER precede DELIMITER; the trailing \b prevents *DESIGN matching *DESIGN_FLOW.
patterns.name: keyword.control.spef.heading

patterns.comment: Power/ground net declarations; capture group 3 colors the rail names.
Net-segment index at start of a CAP/RES/INDUC row
patterns.name: constant.numeric.spef.index

patterns.comment: Connection attributes: *D driving cell, *L load cap. Lookbehind keeps the leading space out of the token.
patterns.name: keyword.other.spef.attribute

patterns.comment: Section headers. INDUC is the IEEE 1481 inductance section; R_NET is the reduced-net section.
patterns.name: keyword.control.spef.section

patterns.comment: Connection labels: *P port, *I instance pin, *N internal node. \b keeps *INDUC/*NAME_MAP from matching.
patterns.name: keyword.other.spef.connection

patterns.comment: Port/pin direction: I input, O output, B bidirectional. Lookbehind excludes the I/P/N of a *I/*P/*N label.
patterns.name: keyword.other.spef.direction

patterns.comment: Catch-all for instance/net names. MUST remain the last pattern, or any rule placed after it becomes unreachable.
patterns.name: variable.other.spef
